audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabrications. (a) content.mid: Subjugate 'steals 20% of your armor and MR' — Riot's text states no percentage at all, only that the amount is doubled over 4 seconds. (b) content.mid and whys[4] gate Wind Slash on '50% HP' and 'a half-HP Trundle' — invented thresholds; the mirror already established Wind Slash scales with MISSING health with no threshold. (c) whys[4] says Blade of the Exile 'extends your melee range past his pillar zone': Pillar of Ice is IMPASSABLE TERRAIN at 1000 range, and extra attack range does not let you walk through terrain.
audit.why: The 20% figure is the kind of number a player builds a decision on, and it came from nowhere. The health thresholds make them hold a 120-second ultimate waiting for a percentage the ability does not check. And the pillar line teaches that range solves terrain, when the actual counterplay is steering the Q chain away from the wall angle he is setting.
audit.corrected: All three removed and replaced with what the kit actually says, in whys[4] and content.mid.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json R text, E text/range 1000/terrain flag

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] warns against letting him 'stack bite charges against you'. Chomp has no charges — it is a single-cast auto-attack reset on a 3.5-second cooldown at 300 range.
audit.why: The flagged autoreset-burst-tell interaction says it plainly: his combo opens with an auto reset, so the WIND-UP is the cue to step back, not the ability cast. A player watching for a cast bar or a stacking counter will already be mid-trade when it lands.
audit.corrected: whys[0] rewritten onto the real Chomp, and wants.foe[1] rewritten onto the auto-reset tell with its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The needs-antiheal interaction lists both King's Tribute AND Frozen Domain, and the content layer names neither. Grievous Wounds appears only in one encoding-damaged report line.
audit.why: King's Tribute heals him whenever ANY enemy unit dies near him — that is every minion in the wave, all lane long, not an ability he has to spend. Frozen Domain then multiplies all of it while he stands on the ice. Together they are why chip damage does not stick, and the page attributes his sustain vaguely to 'passive regeneration'.
audit.corrected: King's Tribute named in whys[0]; Frozen Domain's all-source healing increase written into whys[5].

edits.before: Track Subjugate before every commit — if it is up, take a short trade only (Q1, auto, Q2, out), because the moment he casts it mid-fight it steals 20% of your armor and MR and turns the math sharply against you. His pillar (E) is the other thing to respect — he will try to cube you against your own tower wall or the lane boundary to block your Q-chain dashes; if you feel the pillar coming, steer Q sideways rather than directly into the wall angle he is setting up.
edits.after: Track Subjugate before every commit — if it is up, take a short trade only (Q1, auto, Q2, out), because the moment he casts it he takes a share of your health, armour and MR outright and doubles it over the next 4 seconds. When it is down you have the rest of a 120-second cooldown to work in: run the full combo, and at 6 open with R to extend your range, then Q-W-Q-E-Q into Wind Slash — it scales with the health he is missing, so there is no percentage to wait for. Pillar of Ice is the other thing to respect: impassable terrain at 1000 range that cuts a Q-chain dash off mid-flight, so steer Q sideways rather than into the wall angle he is setting.
